A legendary fourth-generation @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu}, sired directly by the clan's Antediluvian, who directed vampiric minions throughout Russia for centuries. Her command of Thaumaturgy was so impressive she was often mistaken for a sorceress, and her mastery of Obfuscate let her enact grand schemes unnoticed by the mortal populace. A spiritual "Shadow Curtain" surrounded the Soviet Union during her reign, isolating ancient sacred sites from the outside world. Allegedly one of only three @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} who ever escaped their sire's blood bond, acting with a vengeance rivaling the legendary Nictuku.

Slain by Lupines in 1998. With her fall, the Shadow Curtain collapsed and the Soviet Union's supernatural landscape fractured into chaos — Russian @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} now find themselves squeezed between the returning @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} to the west and encroaching Cathayans to the east, and most have chosen to remain hidden and autarkis rather than risk a new overlord.

An outsider even among @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu}, Emmett owes allegiance to no coterie, brood, domain, or sect — only to himself. A master information broker, he trades freely with @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}, anarch, and autarkis @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} alike (at steep prices, always exacted in favors), and is a heavy user of SchreckNET, the clan's shared computer network, where he lurks under numerous false identities.

Recent infamy stems from his claim to be the sole survivor of a Hosting (a gathering of @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} storytellers and historians) that ended in tragedy when tunnels collapsed beneath Manhattan. Emmett alleges the gathering was betrayed to the legendary Nictuku by vengeful autarkis Nosferatu — a claim that has earned him enmity across the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}, and his own clan, and forced him into hiding as an infamous autarkis himself.

A @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} ductus and crusader for the Sword of Caine, specializing in subterranean raids against @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} domains. Skilled at seeing through traps, obfuscation, and defensive strategies other @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} employ to guard their tunnels. Has led at least a dozen War Parties through the netherworlds of @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} cities, with a body count including Kindred nobility and assorted subterranean horrors (ghouled albino alligators, shapechanging rats, fungal chambers, cults of subterranean ghouls). Fights at her pack's vanguard, accepts no quarter, and demands fanatical bloodlust from those who follow her into battle.

One of the most notable Arabian Cainites and a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} primogen of Chicago. Embraced in 1191 by Alexius, a Byzantine @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} and former Eastern Orthodox prelate who sought to corrupt Muslim leaders through the Embrace, choosing the cruel Khalid as a fitting vessel. Horrified at his curse, Khalid slaughtered his own soldiers before fleeing into the desert to starve himself in penitence; a reclusive Jewish hermit saved him and taught him gematria, Kabbalah, and other mysticism, eventually leading him to the myth of Golconda, which became his unlifelong quest.

Wandered the world for six centuries witnessing the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}'s meddling in human history before settling in Chicago in the late 19th century, seeking wisdom from a rumored slumbering Inconnu. Instead found a city rebuilding from the Great Fire of 1871, and was drawn into local Kindred politics through the reigns of Prince Maxwell and Prince Lodin. Now a master of vampiric politics, but still hungry for any lead on Golconda, treating politics as a mere diversion from his true pursuit.

Born Maleki, a talented occult scholar and prelate of Byzantium bound by blood oath to Magnus, a powerful @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.phgt6OMwTAoAaKfR]{Lasombra} hidden within the Eastern Orthodox Church. When Maleki publicly opposed the suppression of Iconoclast monks, Magnus punished him by forcing his Embrace at the hands of a diseased @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} rather than killing him outright.

Rather than breaking him, the Embrace transformed Maleki into a martyr; renaming himself Malachite, he continued warring with Magnus for control of the Orthodox Church as the "Rock of Constantinople." He witnessed Constantinople's fall to the Turks and its transformation into modern Istanbul, and remains there still, presiding over a diverse underground kingdom of @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} broods reflecting many faiths beneath the city's officially Muslim surface, continuing to pray as he has for centuries.

A @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} architect whose subtle influence has shaped human cities across both the Old World and New World for centuries, though he never took credit for his work. After his Embrace, he dedicated himself to architecture and the occult science of geomancy, becoming famous throughout 12th-century Europe for improving castles to include hidden rooms and passages usable by Kindred.

Forced from the Old World by intrigue, Zelios found new commissions in the New World. After a brief, disastrous attempt at @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} primogen politics, he built a thriving career expanding the sewer systems of major cities, applying the same care below ground that he once lavished on castles above. His most elaborate work includes much of New York's subway tunnels and sewer systems — though sadly, much of that legacy has since fallen into @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} hands. His true legacy lies in brick and mortar beneath the greatest cities of North America.
